title: feat(spec,core): a scoped import lookup miss whose value exists under another parent answers reference_out_of_scope
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDqyPrPQvkURDXnUDgkyFWB)_

Part of #36794 (PR-1 of 2: the spec reason and the importer; the Import Wizard text follows in PR-2 on the same branch once this one lands)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added (`ValidateDataIssueSchema.scope`, a new optional key on the import cell error; the new `FieldErrorCode` value is a wire code, no author-writable key)
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md

## 维护者速读

- 导入时，查找列填了一个只在别的父记录下存在的记录（例如合同属于另一个客户），服务端现在单独报“不在本行的范围内”，并把限定它的列和单元格作为数据返回；真正不存在的值照旧报“找不到记录”。
- 这是导入查找报错专题的后半段：上一张已让报错文字带上限定列，这张让依赖错误码的界面（导入向导）也能分清两种情况。
- 只影响导入失败行的错误码和多出的一个可选字段，成功导入不受影响；按旧错误码筛“找不到”的客户端，在这种情况下会收到新码，可整张撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **`FieldErrorCode` gains `reference_out_of_scope`** (`packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`, ADR-0114 D2 closed catalog), beside `reference_not_found`. Ruled route A on the card.
- **Catalog sentence `import_reference_out_of_scope`** in all four platform locales (`packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts`). The English text is byte-identical to the sentence the scoped refusal already shipped with (`Contract: no record matches "CTR-0006" (Account = "Acme")`), now with `{{scope}}` as a parameter, so a deployment can override it under `validation.field.import_reference_out_of_scope` and the other three locales say it in their own word order.
- **`ValidateDataIssueSchema` gains an optional `scope: [{ field, value }]`** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`), present only on an import cell error whose code is `reference_out_of_scope`. This is the thread's route decision, agreed by the seat at claim time: the card asks the Wizard to name the scoping column and its cell while keying on the code and never parsing server prose, and the row result carried no structured column at all. Same `{ field, value }` naming the importer already uses for the columns; additive, optional, Clause-② widening. The contract review below judges it.
- **Core importer** (`packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`, `import-runner.ts`): the #36735 unscoped probe now answers the new reason with the new message key and the `scope` entries; the runner copies `scope` onto the row's `errors` element. A value nobody has keeps `reference_not_found`.
- **A scoped read the field-predicate guard refused is never probed** (`RefMatch.scopeDenied`, `isScopeFieldDenial`). A caller who cannot read the scope field (a hidden `master_detail` field, or the `param` a `dependsOn` entry names) has the scoped lookup refused, so its miss says nothing about where the value lives. Before this PR the probe still ran and the #36735 sentence named the scope; with a code that now claims "under another parent", that answer would be wrong for a record sitting under the row's own parent. It keeps `reference_not_found` and the plain sentence, which is what `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` already says for that caller. The guard is read off the error's declared `details.reason === 'field_predicate_denied'` (the reason all four field-predicate guards answer) naming a scope field, never its message.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`: the new code's `foreign-vocabulary` row (ADR-0112 D6), same wording as its three siblings.
- Docs: `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` field-code table and `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` scoped-lookup section. Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/{errors,export,protocol}.mdx`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (`api/ValidateDataIssue:scope`), the strictness-ledger count for `api/` (537 → 538, the new nested object).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch. `Metadata-protocol: added`, not the claim's `none`: `Check Changeset` reads the new `api/ValidateDataIssue:scope` row in `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` as a key entered, and a kind other than `none` grades the package that carries it at least `minor`.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`: the #36159 describe now pins `reference_out_of_scope` for a `dependsOn` scope and a master scope, by name and by pasted id, single and multi-value, with `errors[0].scope` as data; a value nobody has keeps `reference_not_found` with no `scope` key; the two #33523 pins whose value lives under another master move to the new code; a new pin: a scope the field guard refuses answers `reference_not_found` and no unscoped probe runs.
- `packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts`: a new top-level describe drives the real `POST /data/:object/import` route on a real engine and sqlite with a real `dependsOn` declaration: one row resolves, one answers `reference_out_of_scope` with `scope: [{ field: 'project', value: 'Gemini' }]`, one answers `reference_not_found` with no `scope`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.test.ts`: every locale interpolates `{{value}}` and `{{scope}}`; the English render is the shipped sentence; the zh-CN render.
- Ablation: with `if (scopedMatch.scopeDenied) return refusal;` commented out, the guard pin goes red (1 failed / 15 passed), restored green.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 900 passed (900), Tests 28505 passed, 1 todo.
- `vitest run src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts` (core): 16 passed. `src/utils/import-coerce.test.ts`: passed.
- `vitest run src/import-integration.test.ts` (rest): 62 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 2 stale before `--fix` (references docs, strictness ledger), both green after.
- `typecheck` spec, core, runtime: green; rest: one TS18048 in the new pin, fixed in 2e8b0b96, `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `node scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean exit 0 (main, #37422, #37371).
- The `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived list (118 commands) is running; its reading goes on the PR when done.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Narrowing question left to the contract review, as the card asks:** a client matching `reason === 'reference_not_found'` to mean "the lookup cell did not resolve" stops seeing the out-of-scope case under that value. The schema only widens (a new enum member, a new optional key), so this PR declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; whether the move of that case is itself a narrowing for such a client is the L2's call.
- **Skill text made false, not fixed here (`Skills-docs: follow-up owed`):** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:117` says another master's detail answers `reference_not_found`. `skills/**` is governed, and this PR's `Clause-②: yes` keeps it off the low-risk arm, so the line here would make the whole PR Tier H; the seat files the owed card.
- Between this PR and PR-2 the Import Wizard meets a code it has no `case` for, so `formatDryRunError` falls through to the server's own sentence (already in the caller's locale, naming the scope) on both the dry-run panel and the completion screen. PR-2 gives the code its own Wizard key built from `scope`.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts` `referenceNotFound` (the new reason and the guard), `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts` the resolver's `catch` (`isScopeFieldDenial`), `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` `ValidateDataIssueSchema.scope`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-integration.test.ts -t "under another parent"` — one test, green; row 2 answers `reference_out_of_scope` with its `scope`.
